description: 행정안전부_생활안전지도 해안제방시설 [dams, reservoirs and flood defences] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 행정안전부. 해안제방시설은 태풍, 해일, 해수면 상승 등으로 인한 해안 지역의 침수와 범람 피해를 막기 위해 설치된 제방 구조물을 말합니다. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 행정안전부. Its tags are 해안제방, 연안제방, 침수방지, 방재시설, 공간정보. It offers 1 resource(s) in wms. The portal shows 2025-11-19 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
